## Role at JTP

Eva provides the operational structure around JTP's technical work. Her responsibilities include:

- Publishing and maintaining JTP content.
- Coordinating and leading meetings.
- Tracking actions, timelines and project communication.
- Managing delivery on projects that require additional capacity.

## Education

| Qualification | Institution | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Bachelor's degree in Marketing | Nottingham Trent University | First class |

## Working with Eva

Clients may work with Eva during project planning, meetings and delivery coordination. She helps keep each engagement organised while Jake remains responsible for the modelling and measurement work.
